captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact bench cantilever robotic arm with a three-revolute serial configuration. It is anchored by a dark grey base plate and a short vertical block column, from which the arm extends horizontally to one side. The arm consists of two main, light-grey rectangular links connected by joints, ending in a dark-grey wrist faceplate. The joints allow for rotational articulation along three axes to position the end-effector.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact bench cantilever arm. The assembly should feature a dark grey base plate and column supporting a serial three-revolute arm, consisting of two light-grey links and a dark-grey wrist end-effector, all overhanging to one side.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject and constructs its parts using basic 3D shapes. A base part is created from a flat rectangular plate and a vertical box block. Two subsequent link parts are modeled using rectangular box primitives representing the arm segments. A final wrist/end-effector part is represented by another box. These parts are connected in series via three revolute joint definitions, complete with origin offsets, axis directions, and motion limits.
